critical_code_review_comments: bulkConfigs.js fromListing() in all 5 configs reconstructs the GST-inclusive price as Math.round(base * (1 + gst/100)). priceFromInclusive uses Math.round on the way down, so a stored base of 10000 (saved from typed 11800) will show as 11800 in edit — round-trip works for the example value. Edge case: very small rounding deltas (1-rupee drift) may surface for prices where base*1.18 is a .5 boundary. Acceptable for INR.
